lot: MeloNX lot 8: Metal library cost (worker libraries published to main)

adapt_worker_library_share.what: after a creation compiled in its own cache, the worker merges that cache into main (library references copied, nothing compiled) under the main lock, announced as a holder (render-thread creations go to the side cache), never waiting; skipped when the lock is held, main Frozen, past main's estimated budget (checked before and under the lock) or under low device memory
adapt_worker_library_share.protocol: the checkpoint announcement is a count of holders for every holder of the file (load, play-time and pause checkpoints, shares)
adapt_worker_library_share.budget: an estimate: main's measured bytes + the credit of merges since its last measure + the worker's pipelines since its last share at its bytes per pipeline; bytes per pipeline learnt only from spans without merges; not native memory

realBackendDecision.mergeCost: 24 merges in 0.16-0.23 ms total per session (longest 0.01-0.03 ms)
realBackendDecision.lockHeldByMainHits: a variant served from main creates its pipeline state under the main lock: 166-185 ms per 60 requests (36 hits) against 4-6 ms without sharing; that creation was made before in the worker cache: moved, not added, but a render-thread creation meeting it waits
realBackendDecision.memory: peak footprint +0.5 to +0.7 MiB on the runner (19.2-19.4 -> 19.9-20.1 MiB); the budget check is an estimate, not this measure
realBackendDecision.decision: integrated: 13 of 40 MSL compiles and SPIR-V conversions removed in this pattern (the one-cache lower bound) for a merge cost under 0.3 ms; reset and batched strategies rejected; simultaneous first compilations of the same library are not removed
